chunks: Neither dulling the senses nor intoxicating,

key_terms.غَوْلٌ: Dulling of the senses or confusion caused by intoxication
key_terms.يُنْزَفُونَ: They are intoxicated or become confused

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the wine of Paradise and earthly wine?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the perfection of Paradise's wine by negating the two primary defects of earthly wine: 'ghawl' (bitterness or thick sediment) and 'uzl' (drowsiness or loss of consciousness). This distinction underscores the divine attribute of providing pure, unadulterated pleasure that enhances rather than diminishes the intellect and spiritual awareness of the believers.
